title: Gallai's identity for matching and edge covering numbers
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with minimum degree $\delta(G) > 0$ (so that $G$ has no isolated vertices, and edge coverings exist). Then the matching number and the edge covering number of $G$ satisfy
\[
\alpha'(G) + \beta'(G) = n,
\]
where $\alpha'(G)$ is the largest number of edges in a matching of $G$ and $\beta'(G)$ is the smallest number of edges in an edge covering of $G$.

This is the theorem of Gallai (1959).
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
n is the number of vertices (Fintype.card V)
